svg.text: The existing wall really can act as the spring
Actual refined-mesh nodes at 1N. Blue = undeformed; orange = radial motion enlarged 10×; heights undeformed.
The bottom cut ring is clamped; the rim is free.
The bottom cut ring is clamped; the rim is free.
The broad wall is about 2.5× more compliant in this fixture. That is a real geometry difference, not extra spring boxes.
Both cap and body can flex during a real snap; these separate radial loads are not a holding-force simulation.
Native inputs, mesh refinement, force balance and material assumptions are retained. PETG print behavior remains unmeasured.
